title: Add experiment results API for variant deltas + guardrail status
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Console backend: new read-only results endpoint for route experiments that returns per-variant metrics + deltas and guardrail status (latency/cost/error; optional quality placeholder).
pr_body:
## Summary
This PR adds the first cut of an Experiment Results API that the Console results dashboard can call to display per-variant metrics and basic deltas vs a selected baseline variant, along with guardrail status.

This is intentionally NOT a full experiment analysis engine. It returns computed deltas over fixed time windows and applies existing guardrail threshold evaluation. Significance, advanced analysis, and custom metrics remain out-of-scope for GA (see PRD + leadership scope confirmation).

## Motivation
Console needs a stable, versioned API surface that:
- Aggregates and returns standardized metrics by {route_id, experiment_id, variant_id}
- Produces a simple comparison model (baseline vs others) for the UI
- Exposes guardrail state in a way that aligns with soft-stop/hard-stop pipeline (initially soft-stop)
- Avoids expensive ad-hoc queries from the UI (we use rollup tables + caching)

This API is used by the new Route Experiments results view (tracked separately in Console UI PRs). It also unblocks support/on-call workflows for “results stale / not updating” by making propagation/aggregation timestamps explicit in the payload.

## Design highlights
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}/results`
- AuthZ: RBAC read permission required (reuses existing Console permission bundle; see ENG-9029 follow-ups for fine-grained scopes)
- Inputs:
  - `route_id` (required)
  - `window` (optional; default `1h`; allowed: `15m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `7d`)
  - `baseline_variant_id` (optional; default = control variant if configured; else first variant)
  - `region` (optional; if omitted returns ALL with a best-effort aggregated view)
- Outputs:
  - Per variant: latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput (rps), error_rate, cost_per_1k_tokens, tokens_per_request
  - Deltas vs baseline for key fields (absolute and percentage where applicable)
  - Guardrail evaluation status for each variant (OK/WARN/BREACH) + which guardrail(s) triggered
  - Data freshness metadata: `aggregation_watermark`, `source_rollup_table`, and `attribution_drop_rate` (if available for window)

## Guardrail semantics
- Guardrails are evaluated using configured thresholds at the experiment level. This PR wires the same evaluator used by the experiment guardrail pipeline, but invoked in read-mode for results.
- We intentionally do not mutate experiment state from this endpoint.
- If guardrail config is missing, we return `guardrails.status = "NOT_CONFIGURED"`.

## Implementation details
- Data source: analytics rollup table produced by the telemetry aggregation job (ENG-9027). This PR adds a small query adapter + shaping layer for Console.
- Cardinality constraints: request-level / span-level raw data is not queried from Console; only rollups. Variant_id and experiment_id are already bounded. Route_id normalization follows the route template id (not raw path) to reduce cardinality.
- Caching:
  - In-process LRU (per Console API pod) keyed by `(experiment_id, route_id, region, window)` for 30s.
  - Defensive timeouts (db query timeout 2s) and graceful degradation: if data unavailable, payload includes `data.status = "NO_DATA"` and freshness info.

## API shape (example)
Response fields are stable but marked `beta` in the OpenAPI doc. Example:
- `baseline_variant_id`: "v0"
- `variants`: array of rows with `metrics`, `deltas_vs_baseline`, `guardrails`
- `window`: "1h"
- `aggregation_watermark`: RFC3339 timestamp

## Testing
- Unit tests for:
  - Delta calculation (including percent calculation edge cases when baseline is 0)
  - Guardrail evaluation mapping to UI statuses
  - Window validation
- Integration-ish tests (db-backed in CI) for:
  - Query returns deterministic ordering
  - Region filter works
  - Missing rollup rows returns NO_DATA but 200

## Operational notes
- Adds structured logs for slow queries and includes experiment_id/route_id for correlation.
- Adds metric: `console.experiments.results_api.query_latency_ms` and `console.experiments.results_api.cache_hit_ratio`.

## Links
- ADR-048: experiment metrics attribution schema
- PRD: Route-level A/B testing framework
- Related PRs: attribution plumbing + rollups (pr-28503), dashboard UI work (separate)
- Support: SUP-24910 (Console results appear stale) — this PR makes aggregation watermark visible so the UI can display it.

## Checklist
- [x] OpenAPI updated
- [x] RBAC read-gate enforced
- [x] Added tests
- [x] Added basic caching + query timeout
- [x] Added metrics/logging

## Follow-ups
- Add optional quality metric stream integration once eval hook stabilizes (ENG-9035)
- Consider per-model breakdown (currently aggregated across model_id for the route/variant)
- Add pagination / downsampling for longer windows if needed (7d charts can be expensive in UI even with rollups)
commits: console/experiments: add results controller and DTOs
analytics: query adapter for experiment variant rollups + window validation
guardrails: expose read-mode evaluation helper for results endpoint
tests: add delta and guardrail mapping coverage
observability: add results_api latency + cache hit metrics
review_conversation: Logan Wright: Can we include attribution drop rate in the response? It’s been a leading indicator for “results look wrong”. Also please confirm we’re only querying rollups, not raw spans.

Chloe Martin (author): Added `attribution_drop_rate` when available for the window and confirmed query path is rollup-only. Also added `aggregation_watermark` and `source_rollup_table` to make freshness explicit.
Mei Lin: For longer windows, are we doing any time-bucketing? UI might want a timeseries not just a single aggregate. Also please document window constraints.

Chloe Martin (author): This endpoint is single-window aggregate only (v0). UI timeseries will use a separate endpoint or an extension; documented allowed windows and added validation errors. Kept shape small for MVP.
Rafael Mendes: Guardrail status mapping: please ensure we distinguish NOT_CONFIGURED vs OK. Also add query timeout + a metric for slow queries; we’ve seen DB pressure from results queries in staging.
Chloe Martin (author): Done. Added query timeout=2s, slow query structured log, and `console.experiments.results_api.query_latency_ms`. Guardrail states now include NOT_CONFIGURED/OK/WARN/BREACH.

Jordan Lee: Baseline variant selection should match control variant semantics from experiment config; avoid picking “first variant” if control exists. Also please confirm region aggregation semantics: we should not accidentally mix regions if the UI expects region-specific.

Chloe Martin (author): Baseline selection now uses configured `control_variant_id` when present, else falls back to first stable ordering. Region: if omitted, we return an `ALL` aggregate computed from the rollup’s global aggregate; if region provided we filter strictly. Added explicit `region` echo field in response.
Dylan Brooks: Looks good for MVP. One request: add an explicit `data.status` field so UI can show a consistent empty state and avoid interpreting missing arrays. Also ensure OpenAPI marks it beta.
Chloe Martin (author): Added `data.status` = OK|NO_DATA|PARTIAL and marked endpoint beta in OpenAPI. Pushed additional tests for NO_DATA case.
final_comment: Merged. Thanks all. Follow-ups for timeseries endpoint + quality metrics will be tracked separately; this should unblock the Console results dashboard MVP.
